profile.name: Muddusar Zulfiqar
profile.title: Senior Software Engineer
profile.tagline: Building fast, accessible, and scalable web apps with React, Next.js & TypeScript
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years building fast, accessible, and scalable web applications for international clients and distributed teams. Specialized in React, Next.js, Vue.js, Nuxt.js, and TypeScript, with strong full-stack depth across the MERN and MEVN stacks — Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB — plus hands-on experience integrating AI/ML features using Python and modern AI APIs. Currently a Senior Software Engineer and frontend lead at PureLogics, mentoring a team of 15 engineers and owning delivery from architecture through launch in remote-first, cross-functional environments.

description: Progressed from Software Engineer to Senior Software Engineer, leading frontend development across multiple scalable web applications for international clients.
Mentor and provide technical guidance to a team of 15 engineers, raising team-wide code quality and delivery through code reviews, pair programming, and hands-on coaching.

Architected responsive interfaces in React.js, Vue.js, and SCSS, improving Lighthouse performance scores by 25% and reducing page load times by 30% via code splitting, lazy loading, and reusable component architecture.
Contribute to architectural and strategic decisions across TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB, aligning technical solutions with broader business objectives.
Collaborate asynchronously with cross-functional, distributed teams to ship features on schedule in a remote-first environment.
Built responsive, high-performance web applications in React.js and Next.js, delivering consistent experiences across devices.
Implemented accessible, multilingual interfaces with strong attention to UI/UX and performance optimization.
Partnered with cross-functional teams to ship goal-aligned frontend solutions and adopt modern workflows.
Delivered frontend development for international clients across 20 projects, building responsive interfaces to high code-quality standards.
Translated client requirements into clean, maintainable React and JavaScript components under tight timelines.
Developed visually polished, responsive user interfaces with React.js, Vue.js, jQuery, and SCSS, maintaining high code-quality standards.
Stayed current with modern tools and techniques to continuously improve delivery quality and consistency.
Built responsive, scalable interfaces with JavaScript, jQuery, and Liquid that integrated cleanly with backend systems.
Contributed to website development and company-profile management, strengthening core web development and communication skills.

projects.title: Sliced Health

Consistent, accessible UI using a Material UI component system
Performance-tuned rendering for large, data-dense views

features: Responsive frontends in React.js and Vue.js
Node.js / Express.js REST API integration and authentication
Reusable component library standardizing UI across the app
TypeScript end-to-end for maintainability and type safety

projects.title: Melbourne City Limo

REST API integration with a Node.js / Express.js backend
MongoDB-backed reservation and customer data
